Name: BJS Time Skipper
Author: bunnyjumps
Description:
Press "Z" (changeable inside the config) to open the menu, which allows you to skip up to 336 days. No more walking left and right inside your bed.

[img]http://media.giphy.com/media/54YbtCxhC7vDi7jz4B/giphy.gif[/img]

[size=5]How to use[/size][list=1]
[*]Press "Z".
[*]Select the number of days you would like to skip.
[*]Click the SET button.
[*]Relax and drink a coffee or two.
[*]Press "Z" again to stop skipping.
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
